name: PreviewTrigger
summary: Shows delayed preview content while a trigger is hovered or focused.

useWhen: Showing a lightweight preview before navigation

obligations: Open from pointer, touch long press, and keyboard focus.
Allow interactive preview content to remain reachable without trapping focus.

behavior: Delegate delayed hover, safe-area pointer transit, touch long press, keyboard handling, and teardown to RAC PreviewTrigger.
Keep preview content non-modal and support controlled or uncontrolled open state.
accessibility: Require a focusable trigger and an accessible name for the interactive preview.
Expose dialog semantics without focus containment so the trigger and preview remain reachable.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
